claims: C1 when the assistant sends a message to a tool, the tool response is appended as a new message with role=tool
C2 after that append, the assistant is invoked again

concepts.name: tool_definition
concepts.gloss: T is a program that can be called by the assistant to perform a specific task

concepts.name: message_role_definition
concepts.gloss: message M has role R, where R is one of system, developer, user, assistant, tool, and the role specifies the message's source and determines authority in conflicts

concepts.name: assistant_sends_to_tool
concepts.gloss: the assistant sends message M to tool T

concepts.name: tool_response
concepts.gloss: R is the response produced by tool T in reply to the assistant's message
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of 'the tool response' to the assistant's message, so a response must be associated with the tool that produced it

concepts.name: appended_as_tool_message
concepts.gloss: response R is appended to the conversation as a new message whose role is tool

concepts.name: assistant_invoked_again
concepts.gloss: the assistant is invoked again after the tool response is appended

ontology.gloss: the tool response R is appended as a new role=tool message following the assistant's message M
the assistant is invoked again after the tool response to message M is appended
ontology.body: assistant_sends_to_tool(M, T), tool_response(R, T), appended_as_tool_message(R, M)
